heading: Tuesday, March 17, 2026
topLine: OpenAI releases GPT-5.4 mini and nano.

items.headline: OpenAI releases GPT-5.4 mini and nano
items.summary: GPT-5.4 mini and nano are smaller, faster versions of GPT-5.4 aimed at coding and subagent workloads; mini has a 400K context window and is available to free ChatGPT users, while nano is API-only.
